purpose: Reduce the selected electroweak C1 primitive response template by fixing basis and matching-scheme conventions without fitting electroweak data.

scheme_counterterm.reason: Finite non-universal counterterms are not selected by the corpus and would otherwise be threshold knobs.

basis_transport.reason: The response vector is defined directly in the selected (U1,SU2,SU3) basis.

forbidden_shortcuts: using observed electroweak couplings or weak angle
choosing non-universal scheme counterterms to repair the split
introducing a basis-transport vector after seeing target data

verdict.next_required_computation: Compute selected local_determinant, torsion_curvature, and bundle_index raw response vectors, or only their summed U1-SU2 difference.
